title: Blood Donation Camp
summary: The Rotary Club of Mumbai Crown (RCMC) successfully organized a Blood Donation Camp on 23rd August 2026 at Celebration Hall, Rustomjee Crown, Prabhadevi, in collaboration with KEM Hospital.
description:
The Rotary Club of Mumbai Crown (RCMC) successfully organized a Blood Donation Camp on 23rd August 2026 at Celebration Hall, Rustomjee Crown, Prabhadevi, in collaboration with KEM Hospital.

The camp resulted in 73 successful blood donations, with 18 RCMC volunteers contributing 8 service hours to this lifesaving initiative.
